## Change

Describe the improvement and why it belongs here. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Evidence and verification

For phone-specific changes, include manufacturer, model, Android version, build, and ADB connection. For performance or storage claims, include the conditions and measured result. Describe any rollback or restore check and note gaps in testing.

- [ ] I ran the relevant checks and updated the documentation where needed.
- [ ] Screenshots, logs, and examples are free of personal information.
- [ ] For changes that write to the device, I verified the applicable approval, data preservation, and recovery behavior.
